## Problem and resulting behavior

## Source evidence

For tax, merchant or alias changes, cite the exact source, date and FAQ question or PDF page. Record interpretations in `docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md`.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Explain skipped checks.

## Review

- [ ] Data and aliases match the cited source and preserve multiple-entity choices.
- [ ] Financial arithmetic uses integer pesewas and meaningful tests cover the change.
- [ ] Keyboard, 360px and language behavior checked when relevant.
- [ ] No personal financial data, trackers, remote scripts or secrets introduced.
- [ ] Documentation and assumptions updated where needed.

If you find this project useful, please consider starring the repository as a small gesture of support. Stars are optional and do not affect how contributions are reviewed.
